noticias.titular: Jose Ramirez reaches 1,000 career RBIs in Guardians' victory
noticias.texto: With a homer in the sixth inning of the Guardians' 5-3 win over the Athletics, Jose Ramirez reached 1,000 RBIs and joined Earl Averill as the only players in club history to reach that milestone.

noticias.titular: Astros SS Carlos Correa's comeback halted after surgery
noticias.texto: Houston veteran shortstop Carlos Correa's attempt to return this year from ankle surgery ended when his doctor said it could put the 31-year-old Astros infielder in jeopardy of not being ready for the start of next season.

noticias.titular: Dodgers closer Diaz returns from IL, available for Giants series opener
noticias.texto: Los Angeles Dodgers closer Edwin Diaz has returned from a monthlong absence due to a neck injury, making him available for Friday's series opener against San Francisco.

noticias.titular: Jared Young to miss rest of Mets' season with concussion
noticias.texto: New York Mets first baseman Jared Young, 31, who was at home resting and recovering Friday, will miss the rest of the season because of a concussion sustained when he collided with pitcher Nolan McLean while trying to field a ground ball Thursday night.
